about: Fictional attack fixtures for npm run test:attacks: the text layer of three supplier invoices for PO-1042 (FICTIONAL_DATA section 13). 'genuine' is the real invoice; 'inflated' bills a higher unit price; 'hidden' is the genuine invoice plus one line printed white on white that tries to steer an assistant. The planted line is test data that Kevin must ignore and flag; it is not an instruction to any reader of this repository.
